artifact_composition_and_review_governan.description: acrgd defines the artifact composition and review domain governance delta. it governs artifact purpose, audience, declared context policy, source selection, composition, transformation, canonical-definition boundaries, format, layout, readability, machine readability, confidentiality, disclosure, language variants, self-review, repair origins, status reporting, revision lineage, publication or submission ready-claim boundaries, cross-domain artifact dependency visibility, and record consistency. it does not replace parent reasoning, behavior, audit, repair, activation, status, registry, orchestration, subject-matter validation, approval, or sibling-domain governance.

domain_scope.scope_statement: acrgd applies when an artifact is generated, composed, transformed, reviewed, repaired, prepared for publication or submission, or checked for format, layout, readability, confidentiality, disclosure, language variant integrity, or record consistency.

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: prevent domain rules from becoming brittle case-specific prohibitions while still allowing context-local specificity when required.

role_complete_separation.principle: acrgd must keep source material, domain definition, inherited governance, sibling reference, artifact composition, artifact review, subject-matter domain validation, disclosure control, format and layout control, external orchestration, decision or approval authority, records, and metadata responsibilities separated.

separation_targets.source_material: inputs or references used to create or review the artifact; source density and order are not copied by default
separation_targets.domain_definition: acrgd-specific artifact composition and review rules, checks, failures, repair origins, and records
separation_targets.inherited_governance: parent governance referenced as authoritative context and not re-expanded inside acrgd
separation_targets.sibling_reference: other domain definitions referenced only when in scope and not absorbed into acrgd
separation_targets.artifact_composition: the structure, density, medium, and transformation strategy of the artifact
separation_targets.artifact_review: the separated checks applied to the artifact after or during generation
separation_targets.disclosure_control: independent handling of confidential, sensitive, unsafe, private, or nonpublic material
separation_targets.format_layout_control: medium fitness, layout integrity, readability, parseability, conversion, and rendering stability
separation_targets.external_orchestration: routing, registry, priority, and activation orchestration remain external to the domain definition
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information remain metadata, not domain rules
separation_targets.subject_matter_domain_validation: validation of architecture, research, software, security, operations, project, audit, legal, or decision content remains with the relevant domain or authority; acrgd may review only the artifactization of that content
separation_targets.ready_claim_boundary: acrgd may block or qualify artifact-ready, publication-ready, or submission-ready claims when artifact boundaries fail; this is not final approval, rejection, or execution blocking
separation_targets.decision_or_approval_authority: final approval, rejection, release, submission, legal, security, or business authorization remains outside acrgd unless explicitly delegated by higher authority

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: prevent acrgd from absorbing sibling domain responsibilities, creating implicit priority conflicts, or treating artifact review as subject-matter validation when artifacts contain architecture, research, software, security, operations, project, audit, legal, or decision content

cross_domain_boundary_policy.purpose: define how acrgd remains responsible for artifactization while preventing intrusion into subject-matter, orchestration, approval, security, legal, audit, project, operation, architecture, research, or implementation authority

confidentiality_and_disclosure_boundary.purpose: separate confidentiality and disclosure safety from artifact quality, format, layout, and publication readiness.

source_import_filter.purpose: select only source material needed for the artifact purpose, audience, declared context, confidentiality boundary, medium, role, and review requirements.

artifact_composition_model.purpose: fix artifact intent, category, role, audience, success condition, composition structure, source mapping, and revision lineage before or during artifact production.

artifact_review_model.purpose: keep artifact review axes separate so that safety, quality, format, layout, role, transformation, governance design, and publication or submission readiness are not collapsed into a single unsupported claim.

format_layout_and_readability_control.purpose: govern format, layout, readability, machine readability, conversion, rendering dependency, visual density, and reviewability through abstract failure conditions rather than format-specific bans.

language_variant_control.purpose: control multilingual artifact variants without hardcoding a specific language-code system as a general rule.

canonical_definition_and_documentation_b.purpose: keep canonical definitions, overview artifacts, specifications, technical documents, schema references, appendices, and checklists role-separated.

technical_specification.description: specification, not a general technical book; it explains major blocks, responsibility boundaries, reading strategy, and operational meaning

technical_document.description: technical document or technical book is requirements-defined case by case

schema_reference.description: not created by default; allowed only when explicitly required by user or requirements definition

repair.purpose: define acrgd-specific repair origins and revalidation scope without reimplementing parent repair cycles.

artifact_composition_record.purpose: record artifact intent, declared context policy, source scope, composition basis, review axes, boundary status, format layout readability status, and revision lineage

artifact_review_record.purpose: record separated artifact review results, detected failures, severity, repair origin, repair application, remaining limitations, and status
